title: 第21章 审讯第22章 亲传之耻
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
小虎看了他一眼。
这个人他了解，外边有谣言传他是副堂主的私生子。
“虎哥虎哥，你要给我说好话啊，我有好处，少不了你的。”殷士杰喋喋不休。
小虎看了他一眼，继续在前面带路。
殷士杰见小虎没有跟曹立一样发火，虽然冷漠，但看起来似乎有机会：“虎哥，曹队怎么了，为什么今天那么不近人情？”
“虎哥？”
“虎哥？”殷士杰嘴巴不停。
小虎转过头来，看了一眼殷士杰，没有曹立示意，他不会对殷士杰采取任何行动。
看完，小虎停住脚步，往身后的曹立走去。“曹哥，这个人听说是……”
小虎和曹立的眼神对视。
“我知道！”
“那我们该怎么对待？”小虎请示。
“他要是烦到你了，该干嘛干嘛，副堂主那边你不用担心，有我。”
小虎眼睛一亮：“是！”
转身离去。
殷士杰被两个小弟架着，见到小虎回来：“虎哥，怎么样，曹队是不是答应放我了？”
见小虎没有回应。
殷士杰还是不死心：“按照我跟司马叔叔的关系，你们不会为难我吧？”
“啪！”小虎一巴掌过去：“能不能闭嘴？”
殷士杰懵逼了。

执法堂的人也太不客气了吧？
套着一个黑色头套的春谷仙子，听到那一巴掌的声音，心里有点高兴。
殷士杰似乎不像传言中那样，执法堂的人要哄着他。
不是传言殷士杰和副堂主的关系没那么简单吗？看执法堂的态度，难不成有猫腻？
春谷仙子这样想着。
等小虎带着殷士杰和春谷仙子离开后，唐金春等三人，来到了曹立旁边。
三个人相互看着，唐金春给欧阳林使眼色，而欧阳林也给唐金春使眼色。
曹立现在是不弱于他们的强者，他们俩也不能命令式的让曹立做什么，况且这还是曹立职权之内的事情。
唐金春咳咳两声：“小曹啊。”
“老唐你说。”
“这个殷士杰……”
曹立提起手来打断唐金春的话：“停，如果你要给那小子求情，大可不必，别的事情都好说，唯独在这方面，我是不能不公的，我可是执法长老。”
唐金春和欧阳林俩人都对视一眼，有一抹无奈。
content_en:
Xiaohu glanced at him.
He knew this person well. There were rumors outside that he was the illegitimate son of the deputy hall master.
"Brother Tiger, Brother Tiger, you have to say good things to me. I have benefits and you are indispensable." Yin Shijie kept chattering.
Xiaohu glanced at him and continued to lead the way.
Yin Shijie saw that Xiaohu was not as angry as Cao Li. Although he was indifferent, he seemed to have a chance: "Brother Hu, what's wrong with Captain Cao? Why are you so unkind today?"
"Brother Tiger?"
"Brother Tiger?" Yin Shijie kept talking.
Xiaohu turned his head and glanced at Yin Shijie. He would not take any action against Yin Shijie without Cao Li's signal.
After reading it, Xiaohu stopped and walked towards Cao Li behind him. "Brother Cao, I heard that this person is..."
Xiaohu and Cao Li looked at each other.
"I know!"
"Then how should we deal with it?" Xiaohu asked.
"If he annoys you, do whatever you have to do. You don't have to worry about the deputy hall master, I'm here."
Xiaohu's eyes lit up: "Yes!"
Turn around and leave.
Yin Shijie was being held up by two younger brothers. When he saw Xiao Hu coming back, he said, "Brother Hu, how are you? Did Team Cao agree to let me go?"
Seeing that Xiaohu didn't respond.
Yin Shijie still refused to give up: "According to my relationship with Uncle Sima, you won't embarrass me, right?"
"Pah!" Xiaohu slapped him: "Can you shut up?"
Yin Shijie was stunned.
Are the people from the Law Enforcement Hall too rude?
Fairy Spring Valley, wearing a black hood, felt a little happy when she heard the sound of the slap.
It seems that Yin Shijie is not like the people in the Law Enforcement Hall trying to coax him.
Isn't it rumored that the relationship between Yin Shijie and the deputy hall master is not that simple? Judging from the attitude of the Law Enforcement Hall, is there something fishy?
Fairy Spring Valley thought so.
After Xiaohu left with Yin Shijie and Fairy Chungu, Tang Jinchun and three others came to Cao Li.
The three people looked at each other. Tang Jinchun winked at Ouyang Lin, and Ouyang Lin also winked at Tang Jinchun.
Cao Li is now a strong man who is not weaker than them, and neither of them can order Cao Li to do anything. Besides, this is still within Cao Li's authority.
Tang Jinchun coughed twice: "Xiao Cao."
"Old Tang, tell me."
"This Yin Shijie..."
Cao Li raised his hand to interrupt Tang Jinchun: "Stop, if you want to plead for that boy, you don't have to. Everything else is easy to talk about, but in this regard, I cannot be unfair. I am a law enforcement elder."
Tang Jinchun and Ouyang Lin both looked at each other with a hint of helplessness.
